title: Windows B: rustc crashes during cold compiles (0xc0000374 heap corruption, 0xc0000005 access violation)
outcome: Windows B: rustc crashes during cold compiles (0xc0000374 heap corruption, 0xc0000005 access violation)
acceptance: The cause of the Windows B rustc crashes is identified with discriminating evidence (hardware memory test, toolchain reproduction, or scanner exclusion), or Windows B is retired as a runner.
Windows B completes a defined number of consecutive cold full compiles of the termal test binary without a rustc crash, as agreed by the coordinator before the run.
